profile_asset_help:
The asset that stores this component's settings.
Create a new profile, or assign an existing one.
no_avatar_root: No avatar root (VRCAvatarDescriptor) found. Place this component directly under an avatar.
switch_no_variants: No variants yet. Add one in the variant list above.
pending_banner:
A variant with no blueprint ID is selected.
Uploading now creates a new avatar from this variant's content.
After the upload, the new blueprint ID is written back to this variant and saved automatically.
operations_header: Operations applied when building this variant
outside_avatar_pick: [Avatar Variant] '{0}' is outside the avatar and cannot be used.
outside_avatar_drop: [Avatar Variant] '{0}' is outside the avatar and was not added.
warn_no_variants: There are no variants. Uploading now uploads to the blueprint ID set on the Pipeline Manager.
warn_no_selection: No variant is selected. Uploading now uploads to the blueprint ID set on the Pipeline Manager.
warn_duplicate_id: Blueprint ID '{0}' is used by more than one variant.
warn_remove_missing: '{0}': removal target '{1}' was not found. The build will fail.
warn_material_missing: '{0}': material swap target '{1}' was not found, or has no Renderer.
warn_material_slot: '{0}': material swap on '{1}' uses slot {2}, which is out of range ({3} slots).
warn_shape_no_renderer: '{0}': blend shape target '{1}' was not found, or has no SkinnedMeshRenderer.
log_marked_pending: [Avatar Variant] '{0}' is queued for a new upload. The blueprint ID was cleared, so the next upload creates a new avatar.
log_wrote_back: [Avatar Variant] Wrote the assigned blueprint ID back to variant '{0}' and saved it ({1}).
asset_edit_hint: Edit this from the Avatar Variant Selector on the avatar.
asset_select_user: Select the avatar using this profile
asset_user_not_found: [Avatar Variant] No avatar referencing this profile was found in the open scenes.

build_no_profile: [Avatar Variant] The AvatarVariantSelector on '{0}' has no profile assigned.
build_hint_switch: Pick a variant again in the Avatar Variant Selector.
build_no_selection: [Avatar Variant] No variant is selected, so uploading exactly as the Pipeline Manager specifies.
build_via_pending: [Avatar Variant] There is no blueprint ID, so building as the queued new-upload variant '{0}'.
build_remove_missing: [Avatar Variant] '{0}': removal target '{1}' was not found. The path may be broken.
build_target_missing: [Avatar Variant] '{0}': target '{1}' was not found. The path may be broken.
build_slot_out_of_range: [Avatar Variant] '{0}': material slot {2} on '{1}' is out of range ({3} slots).
build_shape_missing: [Avatar Variant] '{0}': '{1}' has no blend shape named '{2}'.
